text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Arima Kinen, the race of all races! This is a dream race with all the best runners of the era, and I'm more than ready to throw my hat into the ring!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And ALL my rivals are here! This race is gonna be intense!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: With me being a formidable foe for Yaeno, and her being one of my ultimate rivals, this race really is gonna make our dreams come true!
